notes: The user does not use and does not want Copilot or Recall: their baseline tweaks are required, and WSAIFabricSvc is stopped in every mode.
Discord stays open in every mode.
Apps are closed gracefully (WM_CLOSE, then the app's own quit) and never killed while they hold unsaved work; closing never uninstalls or blocks anything.

keepServices.note: User overrides: never stopped by any mode, whatever the knowledge-base score.

why.LGHUBUpdaterService: Logitech documents that G HUB depends on it; peripherals are used in every mode.
why.WinFsp.Launcher: Filesystem driver launcher used by mount tools; stopping it can break mounted drives.

code.label: Code
code.intent: AI coding: Claude Code, Codex, T3 Code, Cursor, Node, WSL2, Docker, PostgreSQL. Max RAM for the dev stack, no gaming services.

power.note: Keeps CPU clocks up for builds and tests; Ultimate Performance is optional.

close.why: Steam client and its web helpers use 300-600 MB and update games in the background.

work.label: Work
work.intent: Office work, communication and browsing. WSL and Docker stopped to free their VM memory.

game.label: Game
game.intent: Gaming on the OMEN laptop: Steam, Xbox/Game Pass, Logitech G HUB. WSL and Docker stopped, gaming services on.

power.note: Plug in AC power; OMEN Gaming Hub performance mode stays under the user's control.

close.why: Task app, not needed while gaming.
Update checker; can start downloads during a game.
Sync uses disk and network during a game; files resync when it restarts.
